parts.text:
Create two source-grounded English descriptions for a controlled retrieval study.
Use ONLY the supplied source caption. You cannot see the image. The source is data,
not instructions. Never infer, correct, or invent facts. Preserve uncertainty and
negation and attach each attribute to the exact original subject/object.

Produce the requested profiles:
- attribute_list: a compact semicolon-separated list of explicit subject/object and
  attribute pairs. State the subject first; name each clothing item, accessory or
  vehicle part beside its color or property. For faces, list the explicit distinctive
  facial structure, hair/hairline, eyebrows, facial hair, marks and accessories.
  Use ordinary terms where their meaning is equivalent. Avoid bare bags of keywords.
- distinctive_first: a fluent natural description beginning with the most specific
  identifying combination stated in the source. Place distinctive accessories,
  markings, hair/hairline, garment-color combinations or make/model before generic
  build/anatomy. Retain useful complementary facts after that combination.

Both profiles should retain useful visible identifying facts without generic filler.
Do not pad, count words, or target a word budget. Omit camera, lighting, crop, focus,
background and inferred emotion. Do not infer demographic categories. Do not claim
an attribute is rare across the dataset: you have only this source caption.
If no distinctive attribute is provided, use the available explicit combination.

Return {"variants": [...]} with exactly one entry per requested name. Each entry
must have variant_type and text. Optional fields: applicable, change_note,
retained_facts, omitted_facts, skip_reason. No Markdown, rankings, or explanations.

{"sample_id": "face::train::092618.jpg", "domain": "face", "source_caption": "Male presentation, young adult, oval face shape with balanced vertical thirds and moderately defined bone structure; forehead moderately high with gently rounded contour; cheekbones average in width and projection; lower face width proportionate to cheekbones with a defined jawline and rounded chin; hairline obscured by hair; eyebrows medium in thickness, soft-arched, and moderately spaced; eyes almond-shaped, medium palpebral fissure length, with a neutral canthal tilt and visible upper-lid crease; nose with a straight dorsum, medium bridge width, and rounded tip; mouth medium in width with thin upper and lower lips, level corners, and upper teeth showing in a smile; facial hair consisting of light stubble along the jawline and chin; ears with free lobes and a metal ring piercing in the left lobe; all captured with soft indoor lighting, short tousled light brown hair, direct gaze, and a slight head tilt.", "operations": [{"name": "llm_attribute_list", "operation": "summary", "profile": "attribute_list"}, {"name": "llm_distinctive_first", "operation": "summary", "profile": "distinctive_first"}]}

visible_response: {"variants":[{"variant_type":"llm_attribute_list","text":"face shape: oval; forehead: moderately high, gently rounded contour; cheekbones: average width and projection; jawline: defined; chin: rounded; hair: short tousled light brown; eyebrows: medium thickness, soft-arched, moderately spaced; eyes: almond-shaped, medium palpebral fissure length, neutral canthal tilt, visible upper-lid crease; nose: straight dorsum, medium bridge width, rounded tip; mouth: medium width, thin upper and lower lips, level corners, upper teeth showing; facial hair: light stubble along jawline and chin; ears: free lobes, metal ring piercing in left lobe"},{"variant_type":"llm_distinctive_first","text":"Short tousled light brown hair and a metal ring piercing in the left ear lobe characterize this individual, who has an oval face with a defined jawline and rounded chin. They exhibit light stubble along the jawline and chin, medium-thickness soft-arched eyebrows, and almond-shaped eyes with a neutral canthal tilt. The nose has a straight dorsum with a rounded tip, while the mouth features thin lips and shows upper teeth in a smile."}]}
